names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Μαρτίου, «Όσιοι Ζήνων και Ζωίλος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 3 марта ст. ст., name page 832, «Зинон», with the rank words left off. The day’s own line declines the name. The calendar gives him no toponymic, no surname and no epithet on either the line or the link, so the stored form is the bare forename. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports it held by three other folders as a Russian form — `zeno-companion-of-eudoxius`, `zeno-companion-of-peleus` and `zeno-of-nicomedia` — and by three more as a Serbian one, and the fold is read in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 марта ст. ст. — «Св. Зинона и Зоила .»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιοι Ζήνων και Ζωίλος»

attestations.note: One page holds the two of them and its whole notice is one sentence: «Είναι άγνωστο που και πότε τέλεσαν τον δρόμο της ασκήσεως οι Όσιοι Ζήνων και Ζωίλος, οι οποίοι κοιμήθηκαν με ειρήνη» — it is unknown where and when the venerable Zeno and Zoilus finished the road of the ascesis, who fell asleep in peace. Because the site says plainly that it has no place and no time, there is no `dates` object here. It prints the distich «Ζωῆς λύσις Ζήνωνι καὶ τῷ Ζωΐλω / Ζωῆς ὑπῆρξε κρείττονος παραιτία», names no relic and gives no hymn. The corpus keeps nine other men of this name and none of them is on this day.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
